description: Deletes one message in Messages on the Mac, by its id (the "message …" at the end of each line of messages_find and messages_read), from all the owner's devices, kept in Recently Deleted as Messages does: for a sign-in code text once you've used it. Done through Messages' window in the background, never bringing Messages forward; while the Mac is locked, at the next unlock.

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

name: messages_delete
title: Delete a Message
